notes.zh-CN: 优化侧边栏项目操作：添加项目改为文件夹图标和明确文字，与项目内新建会话拉开距离，减少误点；项目行操作扩大点击范围，悬停不再挤动项目名称，并支持键盘聚焦。macOS 为 universal 包，未公证；Windows 安装包未签名；APK 沿用上一版 debug 签名；IPA 为开发签名，仅限团队注册设备。
notes.en: Clearer sidebar project actions: Add project now uses a folder icon and a visible label, with more separation from each project’s new-session action. Larger project action targets, stable project labels on hover, and keyboard focus support. macOS is universal and not notarized; Windows installers are unsigned; the APK retains the previous debug signing identity; the IPA is development-signed for registered team devices only.
